For a beginner, the safest and easiest choice is our 222x2x11 Spice Rack Drawer. It fits in standard 10.6" deep upper cabinets and holds up to 30 standard spice jars in a compact space.
If you prefer a simpler start, the 22x1x11 Spice Rack Drawer is another compact, single-tier option that holds up to 10 standard jars and fits easily in tight spaces. Choosing the "Ready-made" assembly option makes setup effortless, as it arrives fully assembled—you just place the elastic bands and secure it to your shelf with a screwdriver.
